result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback: any commitment is confined to the current 12-month term, may be reduced on 30 days’ notice, and uses a unit-rate true-up rather than a penalty; otherwise, fees apply only to ordered or used Services. The revision is targeted and leaves unrelated restrictions unchanged. Drafting is professional, though Section 12.3’s statement that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment creates some tension with Section 2.1’s allowance for an Order Form commitment.
